C0584.title: Douyin E-commerce Handles Miscategorized and Low-Price Misrepresented Goods
C0584.summary: In May 2026, Beijing Daily relayed a Douyin E-commerce Safety and Trust Center notice saying that the platform had handled 190,000 violating merchants and 13,000 violating creators over the previous three months. The report listed brand confusion, overpromising, quality misrepresentation, and missing qualifications as typical durable consumer goods violations, and said the platform used patrols and special governance to intercept problematic products and protect consumers and platform order.

references.title: Douyin E-commerce Cracks Down on Brand Confusion and Overpromising, Handles 190,000 Merchants in Three Months
